records.title: Is this part covered and was it properly fitted
records.notes: A machine whose first part was replaced and claimed; history is preserved, not overwritten

records.title: Piston pump fitted by an authorised dealer, failed inside the warranty period
records.notes: Expected outcome ELIGIBLE. One work order records two component installations (pump and drivetrain part). Fully evidenced; the failure falls inside the 365-day period.

records.title: Piston pump fitted by an unauthorised service partner
records.notes: Expected outcome NOT_ELIGIBLE. Everything else holds, but the installing dealer's authorized_status is SERVICE_PARTNER, not AUTHORISED.

records.title: Piston pump failed after the warranty period ended
records.notes: Expected outcome NOT_ELIGIBLE. Installed 2025-02-10; 365 days end on 2026-02-10; the failure was on 2026-05-01.

records.title: Second claim for the same pump on the same machine
records.notes: Expected outcome REQUIRES_REVIEW. Eligible on its own facts, but an earlier claim for this part on this machine exists, so a person must review it. The earlier claim is itself decided by the evaluator.

records.title: Pump replaced twice, third unit failed
records.notes: Expected outcome REQUIRES_REVIEW. A was replaced by B and B by C. History is preserved: A and B are REMOVED, C is the current installation; repeated replacement goes to review.

records.title: Pump installation with no technician, work order or evidence
records.notes: Expected outcome INSUFFICIENT_DATA. The installation record says only that a pump was fitted by an authorised dealer. Technician, work order and records are not recorded and are not invented; the installation is INCOMPLETE.

records.title: Wheel hub bearing that is not a verified catalogue part
records.notes: Expected outcome NOT_ELIGIBLE. PRT-022 is approved for the BTS-750 but its catalogue status is UNVERIFIED, so the APPROVED_PART condition fails.

records.title: Verified gear pump fitted to a model it is not approved for
records.notes: Expected outcome NOT_ELIGIBLE. PRT-006 is verified and approved for other models, but no fitment approves it for the KFT-600. The installation exists; the approval does not.
